Question 6
?

Which of the following gives the line integral of the function f(x,y)=ex+y along the quarter-circle x2+y2=25, traversed from the point (−5,0) to the point (0,−5) in the third quadrant?

a
5∫π3π/2e5(cos⁡t+sin⁡t)dt
b
5∫π/2πe5(cos⁡t+sin⁡t)dt
c
25∫3π/22πecos⁡t+sin⁡tdt
d
25∫π3π/2ecos⁡t+sin⁡tdt
e
5∫3π/22πe5(cos⁡t+sin⁡t)dt
